issues: The start-of-end ability targets the wrong objects: source says "select an enemy leader or enemy follower," but parsed targets only anyFollower and cannot hit the enemy leader. It should be encoded as a choice between dealing 2 damage to the enemy leader or to an enemy follower. Implement a target/effect form that supports "enemy leader or enemy follower" selection, or a choose mode that presents those two target classes.

The fanfare healing effect is semantically "give your leader [defense]+1" rather than recover defense, though healLeader is likely the intended implementation and is acceptable if the engine treats both the same.

The spell effect is not a player choice. Replace the choose effect with a sequence or if effect that always summons 1 Draconic Weapon, and if Overflow is active, summons 1 additional Draconic Weapon instead.

The source says "you may reveal up to 2" qualifying cards from the top 5, but parsed searchDeckChoose can only take one card. It should allow choosing 0 to 2 Dragoncraft cards that cost 7 or more from among the top 5, reveal them, add them to hand, and put the rest on the bottom of the deck. Implement a multi-pick top-of-deck search operation with a max chosen count.
The card incorrectly has the keyword "fanfare"; remove it because the source has only an activated ability.

The activated ability is missing "and the Armed trait." In addition to giving a Dragoncraft follower +0/+1, it should also grant or add the Armed trait. Implement an effect operation to grant a trait to a target follower.
